purpose: certify that the Phase-1 pre-registration was built without reading historical stability artifacts, and separate Phase-1 documents from Phase-2 stability machinery
forbidden_uses_in_phase1: historical PASS/FAIL information of individual tangent directions

verification_method.document_scan: PRE_REGISTRATION.md and PRE_REGISTERED_COMPLETION_ENSEMBLE.json cite only canon sources (foundations, formulas, monograph, bridge papers, closure document, status/convention locks); their only mentions of stability-related files are the forbidden-list entries in this audit
verification_method.commit_scan: the Phase-1 commit touches only docs/phase1/*, tools/phase1_freeze_hashes.py, MANIFEST.json, SHA256SUMS; no stability artifact is modified or consumed
verification_method.known_context_disclaimer: the agent session context necessarily contains earlier stability findings (they were reported to the owner before Phase 1); the blinding claim is therefore a DOCUMENT-LEVEL and CODE-LEVEL claim: no forbidden artifact was loaded as input to the principle definitions, and Phase-2 tooling will recompute all stability quantities blind from the frozen definitions

phase2_gate: Phase 2 (blind forward replay of C1 and C3) may start only after the commit containing this package is pushed and its hash recorded in the Phase-2 run log
